contributionMap.claim: Method: Kontorovich's labelled lift (record which experiment produced each observation, then forget labels), with erasure overlaps written as products over counts so that the logarithmic budgets range over a product of simplices and the worst case concentrates each budget on one coordinate; for high signal, a base-(k+1) radix weighting that separates the balanced count vector from all others

limitationTriage.limitation: Whether 9/14 is the exact general constant
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is TV(Pbar^n, Qbar^n) <= (14/9) TV(prod P_i, prod Q_i) for all experiments?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: fixed-seed search over arbitrary finite experiments (labelled n <= 4, alphabets <= 4; shared binary and ternary): nothing above C_n; Remark 4.3 shows a labelled-route proof must be sharp at 14/9

limitationTriage.limitation: Erasure-class constants are not known to bound general experiments
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can general experiments be reduced to erasure experiments?
